title: Project policy
description: The rules the user defines when a project is defined: approval policy, workflow templates and footage folder. The Producer drafts it in 00_admin/policy_proposal.json; it takes effect only when the user approves it and a hook copies it into 00_admin/approvals/policy.json (approval.schema.json, kind policy).

mode.description: batch_window: the user approves a ticket (jobs + window); per_job: a ticket holds exactly one job.

auto_retakes_per_unit.description: Retakes the studio may run inside an approved ticket without asking, within its GPU cap.

mode.description: none: stills from still templates run without a ticket.

only_when_idle.description: Queue a still only when ComfyUI's queue is empty and no H3 job runs; one at a time.

user_choice.description: async_agent_fallback: candidates go to the user, generation continues, the agent chooses if the user hasn't when the still is needed.

name.description: Saved workflow name in C:\CU\user\default\workflows, without .json.
